description: The reporter takes no action themselves. The state does it, in good faith, at scale, and the reporter's name may never appear.
energy_note: He made a phone call. The state did the rest.

description: Even a wholly unfounded referral produces interviews, home visits, disclosure to employers and months of uncertainty. The eventual finding of no concern does not undo any of it.
energy_note: Cleared, after nine months of being investigated.

description: Two weeks after she files for divorce, children's services receive a concern about supervision at the property. The social worker is professional and apologetic and still has to do the visit, and the assessment, and the second visit.
energy_note: A phone call, and four months of proving she is a mother.

aspect: Malicious reporting is almost never penalised
description: Systems are built to encourage reporting, which means bad-faith referrals carry effectively no risk to the reporter.
energy_note: Free to do, expensive to survive.
